entries.title: Lamentations 3:1
segments: ¶I [am] the man [who] has seen affliction by the rod of His wrath.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:2
segments: He has led me and made [me] walk [In] darkness and not [in] light.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:3
segments: Surely He has turned His hand against me Time and time again throughout the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:4
segments: He has aged my flesh and my skin, And broken my bones.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:5
segments: He has besieged me And surrounded [me] with bitterness and woe.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:6
segments: He has set me in dark places Like the dead of long ago.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:7
segments: He has hedged me in so that I cannot get out; He has made my chain heavy.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:8
segments: Even when I cry and shout, He shuts out my prayer.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:9
segments: He has blocked my ways with hewn stone; He has made my paths crooked.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:10
segments: He [has been] to me a bear lying in wait, [Like] a lion in ambush.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:11
segments: He has turned aside my ways and torn me in pieces; He has made me desolate.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:12
segments: He has bent His bow And set me up as a target for the arrow.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:13
segments: He has caused the arrows of His quiver To pierce my loins.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:14
segments: I have become the ridicule of all my people-Their taunting song all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:15
segments: He has filled me with bitterness, He has made me drink wormwood.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:16
segments: He has also broken my teeth with gravel, And covered me with ashes.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:17
segments: You have moved my soul far from peace; I have forgotten prosperity.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:18
segments: And I said, "My strength and my hope Have perished from the LORD."

entries.title: Lamentations 3:19
segments: Remember my affliction and roaming, The wormwood and the gall.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:20
segments: My soul still remembers And sinks within me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:21
segments: ¶This I recall to my mind, Therefore I have hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:22
segments: [Through] the LORD'S mercies we are not consumed, Because His compassions fail not.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:23
segments: [They are] new every morning; Great [is] Your faithfulness.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:24
segments: "The LORD [is] my portion," says my soul, "Therefore I hope in Him!"

entries.title: Lamentations 3:25
segments: The LORD [is] good to those who wait for Him, To the soul [who] seeks Him.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:26
segments: [It is] good that [one] should hope and wait quietly For the salvation of the LORD.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:27
segments: [It is] good for a man to bear The yoke in his youth.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:28
segments: Let him sit alone and keep silent, Because [God] has laid [it] on him;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:29
segments: Let him put his mouth in the dust-There may yet be hope.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:30
segments: Let him give [his] cheek to the one who strikes him, [And] be full of reproach.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:31
segments: For the Lord will not cast off forever.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:32
segments: Though He causes grief, Yet He will show compassion According to the multitude of His mercies.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:33
segments: For He does not afflict willingly, Nor grieve the children of men.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:34
segments: To crush under one's feet All the prisoners of the earth,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:35
segments: To turn aside the justice [due] a man Before the face of the Most High,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:36
segments: Or subvert a man in his cause-The Lord does not approve.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:37
segments: ¶Who [is] he [who] speaks and it comes to pass, [When] the Lord has not commanded [it]?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:38
segments: [Is it] not from the mouth of the Most High That woe and well-being proceed?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:39
segments: Why should a living man complain, A man for the punishment of his sins?

entries.title: Lamentations 3:40
segments: Let us search out and examine our ways, And turn back to the LORD;

entries.title: Lamentations 3:41
segments: Let us lift our hearts and hands To God in heaven.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:42
segments: ¶We have transgressed and rebelled; You have not pardoned.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:43
segments: You have covered [Yourself] with anger And pursued us; You have slain [and] not pitied.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:44
segments: You have covered Yourself with a cloud, That prayer should not pass through.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:45
segments: You have made us an offscouring and refuse In the midst of the peoples.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:46
segments: All our enemies Have opened their mouths against us.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:47
segments: Fear and a snare have come upon us, Desolation and destruction.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:48
segments: My eyes overflow with rivers of water For the destruction of the daughter of my people.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:49
segments: My eyes flow and do not cease, Without interruption,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:50
segments: Till the LORD from heaven Looks down and sees.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:51
segments: My eyes bring suffering to my soul Because of all the daughters of my city.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:52
segments: My enemies without cause Hunted me down like a bird.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:53
segments: They silenced my life in the pit And threw stones at me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:54
segments: The waters flowed over my head; I said, "I am cut off!"

entries.title: Lamentations 3:55
segments: ¶I called on Your name, O LORD, From the lowest pit.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:56
segments: You have heard my voice: "Do not hide Your ear From my sighing, from my cry for help."

entries.title: Lamentations 3:57
segments: You drew near on the day I called on You, And said, "Do not fear!"

entries.title: Lamentations 3:58
segments: O Lord, You have pleaded the case for my soul; You have redeemed my life.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:59
segments: O LORD, You have seen [how] I am wronged; Judge my case.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:60
segments: You have seen all their vengeance, All their schemes against me.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:61
segments: You have heard their reproach, O LORD, All their schemes against me,

entries.title: Lamentations 3:62
segments: The lips of my enemies And their whispering against me all the day.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:63
segments: Look at their sitting down and their rising up; I [am] their taunting song.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:64
segments: Repay them, O LORD, According to the work of their hands.

entries.title: Lamentations 3:65
segments: Give them a veiled heart; Your curse [be] upon them!

entries.title: Lamentations 3:66
segments: In Your anger, Pursue and destroy them From under the heavens of the LORD.
